entry.content: Vercel CDN no longer caches origin responses when includes . VaryCookie tells a cache which request headers may change the response. Because cookies often contain visitor-specific values, varying by can create many cache entries that are rarely reused. The response is still served normally but isn't stored for future requests.VaryCookieYou can identify these responses by checking the header and . The header is set to , and Logs show as the cache reason.x-vercel-cacheMISSvary_key_denied:cookieRun
